description: Portable Windows diagnostics for hardware, temperatures, SMART storage health, stress tests and benchmarks (Beta).
notes: This manifest intentionally tracks upstream Beta releases; version 0.4.1 is a pre-release.
The Data directory is persisted across Scoop updates because SMD Win stores benchmark results there.
The application requests administrator rights for hardware and Windows diagnostics. PawnIO is an optional driver and is not installed by this manifest.
